title: Pendant Fixture E-06
audience: design-conscious homeowners choosing a made-to-order pendant light
interior designers comparing material, size, lead time, and installation needs
pageJob: Help a buyer configure one fictional made-to-order pendant with confidence by making material, dimensions, price, lead time, installation, returns, and repairability legible.

facts.statement: The fictional pendant is available in brushed aluminium, oxidised brass, and blackened steel.
Diameter options are 320 mm, 480 mm, and 640 mm with dimension-specific prices of GBP 420, 560, and 720.
The fictional made-to-order lead time is four to six weeks before dispatch.
Hardwired ceiling installation by a qualified electrician is required; the ceiling rose and two-metre cable are included.
Configured made-to-order pieces may be returned only for defect or damage; statutory rights are not reduced.
The fictional LED module and driver are replaceable through a paid repair service for eight years after purchase.

requiredContent: material and size selector with price updates
four-to-six-week lead time before purchase action
made-to-order returns boundary and statutory-rights statement
replaceable module and eight-year repair-service information
constraints: Do not invent product photography, lifestyle rooms, reviews, awards, stock status, or sustainability certification.
Selection cannot depend on colour alone and must be keyboard operable.
Price, lead time, and selected configuration must stay synchronized.
Do not hide installation or returns information below an irreversible purchase action.

assetPolicy.instruction: Use benchmark-authored CSS, material notation, dimension drawings, and configuration UI; no external product or lifestyle media is supplied.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
